column3: NKJV includes “And the angel stood,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “the God of the earth,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord of the earth.”
NKJV has “their dead bodies … our Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “their dead body … their Lord.”
NKJV has “The kingdoms of this world have become the kingdoms,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom.”
NKJV includes “and who is to come,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
